geometry.foreign_body_crop_check: passed with original3px padding and separated-body guards; no relaxation

visual_review.source_identity: Preserves the installed portrait silhouette/palette: tall black hat with purple/red band, purple/gold coat and split tails, dark trousers/boots, pale gloves and a small held white card.
visual_review.idle_articulation: In phase1 the shoulders/upper torso settle and card-side elbow/card angle lower/change slightly; glove/hip position and coat folds relax. Boot soles remain in a stable planted stance while upper-body landmarks articulate. These are16 independently drawn, nonidentical breathing/rest poses, not a single still translated to fake motion.
visual_review.eight_directions: E/W opposite profiles; SE/SW more frontal face/chest; S fully frontal; N fully rear with no front face; NW/NE rear coat/arm occlusion. Card hand is viewer-right in S and viewer-left in N, with the other glove on the opposite hip/back.

E_vs_SE_axis_assessment.conclusion: E is a deliberate camera-open resting torso twist while head/foot direction remains east, rather than a reused SE view. Accepted for idle scope.
E_vs_SE_axis_assessment.head: E nose/chin silhouette points right with a near-side profile; SE exposes a broader frontal cheek/face beneath the brim.
E_vs_SE_axis_assessment.feet: E far boot points predominantly right and the near boot opens diagonally right; in SE both toe axes turn further toward screen-down, especially the near boot.
E_vs_SE_axis_assessment.torso: E gold vest/chest remains visible because the hip/card presentation twists the torso toward the camera. SE has broader frontal vest exposure and different forearm/coat overlap. A torso-facing angle alone is not treated as the movement direction.
E_vs_SE_axis_assessment.next_scope: This idle decision does not certify future gait or attack axes. E walking must progress right with genuine leg phases and E attack contact must point toward the actual east target.

visual_review.connections: All16 preserve connected head/hat, two arms/gloves with held card, coat tails, two legs and complete boot soles. No neighboring body, detached card, extra limb or cutoff brim/toe was found.
visual_review.transparency: No broad visible halo/matte: alpha>25 count beyond3px from alpha>100 silhouette is0, maxalpha23. Remaining sparse low-alpha antialias fringes were retained unchanged.
visual_review.authored_inference_limit: New human face/finger detail, fine vest/jewel pattern and A/heart card marks are newly authored interpretations of an unresolved low-resolution source, not verified original game details.

acceptance_limits: Walk/attack/hit/death, actual Main foot contact, combat and drops remain untested.
